items.source_en:
Judith Tatienne: Any word from Sienar on the TIE Fighter Project?

Victor Aiza: They’ve gotten the design down and are forwarding us the specs. The only thing that confuses me is that it doesn’t seem to have a hyperdrive.

Judith Tatienne: No hyperdrive? That’s absurd. Surely they’ve made a mistake. It would go against everything the Republic stands for.

Victor Aiza: Judith...

Judith Tatienne: If something were to happen to their home ship, they would effectively be stranded in deep space.

Victor Aiza: Nevermind that. Are you feeling okay, Judith? You don’t look so good.

Judith Tatienne: What? Yeah… I’m okay. Just been having some strange dreams. That’s all.

Victor Aiza: Get some sleep Judith. You’re already ahead of schedule for all your assigned projects. Some rest won’t hurt you.

locations.vanilla_source_en:
Judith Tatienne: I just don't understand where these calculations came from.

Victor Aiza: There something wrong with the math? I think it's quite straightforward.

Judith Tatienne: That's not what I'm asking! We've had no success extracting even a sample of material from the object. No explanation for the gravitational effects. No motion graph to explain its harmonic frequencies. I can't even a establish a melting point!

Victor Aiza: Judith...

Judith Tatienne: But you've had me building these prototype colliders for months! And now you want me to pump Helium-3 into it based on this equation you've written on a god-damned napkin!

Victor Aiza: I just need you to trust me.

Judith Tatienne: I HAVE been trusting you! We keep slamming our heads against a brick wall, getting nothing, and you keep coming up with something new to try, like you know what's going to happen! Where are you getting your information, Victor?

Victor Aiza: I'm sorry, Judith. I... look, not here, okay? Somewhere off-base. I'll tell you everything. But... I'm not lying okay? We're going to discover something important here. I promise.

To: Helga Dubray
From: Diego Monroe
Subject: Get well soon

Heard you're finally up and about. Like they say, any landing you can walk away from, right?

items.source_en:
Credits are the lifeblood of the Collective. Our entire operation would not exist if not for the blood, sweat, and bullets of the pirates doing the work, and the consolidation of their earnings here at the Key.

So let me make myself clear: while we have facilities outside the Key, I expect any funds outside of standard operational costs to be brought back to the Reckoner's Core. We've had incidents where Fleet members have taken over operations on various planets throughout the Galaxy, and skimmed a little too much off the top.

Suffice to say, they paid a steep price for their lack of transparency. Make sure you don't do the same.

-- Shinya Jedha, Fleet Reckoner
